# Copy a file path

<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Copy either the absolute path of a file or its path relative to the selected workspace.

## Copy a file path
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

1. In the Files sidebar section, right-click a file row.
2. Select **Copy absolute path** or **Copy relative path**.
3. Paste the copied path where you need it.

Heidrun shows the copied path in a message.
